stance_basis: authorized NFTA and appropriated $86 million for rail transit and bus network
summary: The New York State Legislature is described as having authorized the NFTA in 1967 and, in 1971, formally authorized the creation of a regional bus network and the design and construction of a rail transit line in the Buffalo-Amherst Corridor, appropriating $86 million for these activities plus a separate $7.8 million for the Transportation Center. In July 1975, the State allocated an additional $16 million for the rail transit system, demonstrating continued legislative support for the project.

summary_quote: In 1971, the New York State Legislature authorized the NFTA to proceed with creation of a regional bus network and the design and construction of a rail transit line in the Buffalo-Amherst Corridor; $86 million was appropriated for these activities.
